services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Bring your class, Scout group, PTA group, or after-school program to Beck Center for the Arts for a one-of-a-kind arts experience! Our Arts Sampler Field Trip is designed to introduce students to multiple art forms in a fun, hands-on, and engaging format, guided by our top-notch faculty. In just two hours, your students will get a taste of the creative world as artists, actors, musicians, and dancers, rotating through a series of mini workshops that provide real arts experiences. Workshops are intentionally small to ensure students get personal attention and meaningful instruction in each discipline. World Class Care is set in a not-so-distant future, where two powerful hospital systems have expanded to control nearly all of Cleveland-except for one stubborn homeowner who stands in their way.
